description: County Electric Vehicle Home Charging Access Shares from the 2030 National Charging Network Study is a data set deposited in DOE National Library of the Rockies (NLR) Repository by its authors Yanbo Ge, Eric Wood (National Laboratory of the Rockies). This file contains modeled county-level home electric vehicle (EV) charging access shares from the study, "The 2030 National Charging Network: Estimating U.S. Light-Duty Demand for Electric Vehicle Charging Infrastructure" by Wood et al. (2023). Coverage: a single site or case study; the metadata date the deposit to 2024. The formats are not stated in the metadata. Size stated: 1 files.. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is not stated (no licence in the DataCite metadata read on 2026-09-29).
